items.title: 'We should win this': Tigresses face do-or-die UAE clash for India semifinal
items.summary: It is a do-or-die affair for Bangladesh as they take on the UAE in their final Group B fixture of the Women's Asia Cup on Tuesday, with a semifinal berth on the line.

items.title: Big Bash calling for Nahid Rana?
items.summary: Bangladesh speedster Nahid Rana is drawing interest from Australia’s Big Bash League (BBL), with franchises eager to secure the pacer for the upcoming edition, sources have confirmed to The Daily Star on Monday.

items.title: Asian Games accommodation not an issue, says cricket coach Salahuddin
items.summary: Accommodation will not be a concern for Bangladesh at the upcoming Asian Games cricket event in Japan, according to men’s team head coach Mohammad Salahuddin, despite concerns raised over the facilities by India.

items.title: Nigeria edge Zimbabwe in thriller to qualify for Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup
items.summary: Nigeria are the second African team after South Africa to qualify for the Under-19 World Cup in Bangladesh and Nepal next year

items.title: Stability ensures crucial opportunity for Shanto before T20 WC
items.summary: For Shanto, that improvement has opened the door to a T20I return, while the Asian Games provide a platform to begin building his role as a stabilising presence ahead of the T20 World Cup.

items.title: Mushtaq keen on Pakistan job but admits he is ‘scared’ of PCB treatment
items.summary: Mushtaq, who is currently working as Bangladesh's spin-bowling coach, said the lack of job security and what he described as emotional decision-making within the PCB are major concerns for him.

items.title: Samarawickrama's composed knock seals Sri Lanka's semi-final berth
items.summary: Samarawickrama's unbeaten 48 and Praboda's career-best three wickets helped Sri Lanka survive Bangladesh scare

items.title: Harshitha sinks Tigresses as Sri Lanka seal semifinal spot
items.summary: Bangladesh staged a spirited fightback with the ball at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium, but Harshitha Samarawickrama's brilliant unbeaten 37-ball 48 carried Sri Lanka to a four-wicket win and into the Women’s Asia Cup semifinals.

items.title: Gunaratne in as SL bowl; Easmin debuts for Bangladesh
items.summary: Sri Lanka have dominated Bangladesh in the format with 13 wins from 16 matches

items.title: UAE keep semi-final hopes alive after convincing win over Indonesia
items.summary: They now have to beat Bangladesh on September 8 and also hope other results go their way
